subject: Instrumentation integrations & Ops onboarding — dashboards, tracing, alerts
messages:
From: Ava Chen <ava@clearsight.ai>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: engineering@clearsight.ai
Date: Tue, 25 Jul 2028 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Getting started: Redwood observability handoff and integration questions

Hi Soojin / Monica,

Thanks for the chat this morning. We’re excited to get Redwood’s observability stack wired into ClearSight. To make the onboarding efficient, we want to confirm a few things up front so our SRE and product-ops teams can prepare: 

- Dashboards: we currently have a Grafana workspace; will Redwood provide a dashboard JSON export or do you recommend landing panels into our Grafana?
- Tracing hooks: we use OpenTelemetry (Go services) — we can add hooks but would like your recommended instrumentation points (request boundaries, model inference span, client-side pre/post processing).
- Error taxonomy: do you have an initial classification we should map to (e.g., model-timeouts, tokenization-errors, rate-limit, quota-denied)?
- Alert routing: we want alerts to go to our #platform-alerts Slack and create P1 on-call pages for model-latency SLO breaches. Any suggested thresholds or escalation playbooks?

We can share onboarding windows next week. Attaching a short runbook and a ZIP of our current dashboard panels for context.

Thanks,
Ava
Ava Chen
Head of Product Ops | ClearSight Analytics
[Attachment: clearsight_dashboards.zip (ZIP)]

From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ava Chen <ava@clearsight.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 26 Jul 2028 09:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Getting started: Redwood observability handoff and integration questions

Hi Ava — great to see this level of prep. Quick answers inline and a proposed short plan below.

- Dashboards: we’ll provide a Grafana JSON export and a Redwood dashboard template. Uploading the template into your Grafana is straightforward; we can also serve a hosted view for the first 30 days if you want a preview.
- Tracing hooks: OpenTelemetry support is standard. Recommended spans: incoming request, request->preprocessing, inference invoke (include model name & token counts as span attributes), postprocessing. I’ll attach small code snippets for Go OTEL hooks.
- Error taxonomy: we maintain a default taxonomy (model.timeouts, model.outputs.invalid, infra.gpu_oom, infra.network_err, quota.rate_limit, auth.kms_failure). We can map to yours and push a normalization layer so alerts use your labels.
- Alert routing: suggest two tiers — S1 (latency > 2x p95 for 5m) -> #platform-alerts + PagerDuty; S2 (error rate spike > 3% sustained 10m) -> #platform-alerts + email duty. We’ll include a playbook for paging, runbook links, and an automatic incident-assignment PR that tags your on-call.

Proposed short plan (we can convert into a mutual action plan doc):
1) Kickoff & permissions (Day 0): share Grafana write access or accept import JSON.
2) Instrumentation (Day 1–2): apply OTEL snippets to 2–3 critical services.
3) Dashboard import & sanity checks (Day 3): import template, validate panels.
4) Alert tuning & runbooks (Day 4–5): iteratively tune thresholds.
5) Readout and handoff (Day 7): confirm post-cutover ops owners.

I’m attaching our initial runbook, the Go tracing snippets, and a dashboard schema diagram. Proposed POA: internal onboarding session Thursday 10:00am PT — does that work for you?

Best,
Soojin
Soojin Lee
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: obs_runbook_v1.pdf (PDF)]
[Attachment: tracing_hook_snippets.txt (TXT)]

From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ava Chen <ava@clearsight.ai>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 27 Jul 2028 08:17:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Getting started: Redwood observability handoff and integration questions

Thanks — adding a couple implementation details and owners from the CS side so we have clear responsibilities during the week: 

Implementation notes / ask list:
- Export format: will deliver Grafana JSON + a short import note. If you prefer Redwood-hosted preview, indicate an allowlist IP for temporary access.
- Sampling strategy: recommend adaptive sampling on inference spans (keep full traces for errors and 1/100 for successes by default).
- Sensitive attributes: we will redact PII and full prompts at ingestion; we need to agree on which prompt fields are allowed in span attributes.
- Runbook ownership: Redwood will own the initial playbook drafting; ClearSight will validate and own final runbook in your runbook repo.

Owners: Soojin (tech lead, Redwood), Monica (CS lead, Redwood), Ben (observability engineer, Redwood), ClearSight SRE (implementation), ClearSight Product Ops (alert validation).

We’ll bring a checklist to the Thursday session: OTEL config, dashboard import, alert channels, sensitive field agreement, post-cutover test plan.

— Monica
Monica Patel
Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: dashboard_schema.png (PNG)]

From: Ava Chen <ava@clearsight.ai>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwoodinference.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: engineering@clearsight.ai, Product Ops <ops@clearsight.ai>
Date: Thu, 27 Jul 2028 09:01:23 -0700
Subject: Re: Getting started: Redwood observability handoff and integration questions

On Thu, Jul 27, 2028 at 08:17 AM Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwoodinference.com> wrote:
> We’ll bring a checklist to the Thursday session: OTEL config, dashboard import, alert channels, sensitive field agreement, post-cutover test plan.

Thanks, Monica — that plan looks solid. A couple clarifications: 

- We will allowlist Redwood preview IPs for 48 hours.
- Sampling: agree on error-based full traces; we’ll accept 1/200 sampling for successful calls to start.
- Prompt redaction: will redact full user prompt text at ingestion and provide hashed summary as an attribute. Need Redwood guidance on acceptable summary length.

We’re good for the Thursday 10:00am PT session. I’ve added a Jira ticket (CSIGHT-412) to track the work and invite the SREs.

Ava
Ava Chen
Head of Product Ops | ClearSight Analytics

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ava Chen <ava@clearsight.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwoodinference.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 29 Jul 2028 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Action plan & owners — ClearSight observability onboarding

Folks — pulling this thread together into an action plan we can reference after the kickoff: 

1) Kickoff session (Thu 10:00am PT) — attendees: Soojin, Monica, Ava, ClearSight SREs, Ben. Agenda: permissions, OTEL snippet rollout, dashboard import test, alert routing smoke test.
2) Instrumentation sprint (Day 1–2) — Ben to provide OTEL snippets and a short PR checklist. ClearSight SREs to instrument 3 services and run smoke traces.
3) Dashboard import (Day 3) — Jonas to assist with Grafana JSON import and panel mappings. Validation: panels render, datasource mapping correct.
4) Alert tuning (Day 4–5) — Monica & ClearSight Product Ops to run a 48-hour tuning window. Redwood will push suggested thresholds and sampling changes.
5) Final handoff (Day 7) — ClearSight accepts runbook; ownership formally handed to ClearSight runbook repo.

Notes / Deliverables: obs_runbook_v1.pdf (Redwood draft), tracing_hook_snippets.txt (Go OTEL examples), dashboard_schema.png (panel layout). I’ll open CSIGHT-412 and attach the artifacts.

If there are no objections, I’ll post the meeting invite and a short Miro board for the session prep.

Thanks — Ben
Ben Carter
Observability Engineer | Redwood Inference
